sources.identity: Math-Shepherd: Verify and Reinforce LLMs Step-by-step without Human Annotations
sources.revision: arXiv v3, updated 2024-02-19T14:07:53Z; ACL Anthology 2024.acl-long.510, pages 9426-9439
sources.paper_licence: UNVERIFIED; Crossref returned no license field and no dataset-specific licence was stated in inspected material
schema_evidence_from_paper: Automatic construction starts from a problem, intermediate solution steps, and a golden answer.
A completer generates multiple subsequent paths from each prefix.
Hard estimation labels a step by whether any decoded continuation reaches the golden answer; soft estimation uses the proportion of successful continuations.
The paper reports GSM8K and MATH construction/evaluation but does not provide a released-record JSON schema.
blockers: No official project repository or dataset card was located from the official paper, ACL Anthology record, or bounded repository search.
The github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-LLM link in the paper bibliography is a cited DeepSeek-LLM repository, not a Math-Shepherd project repository.
No released dataset body or data schema was accessed.
sources.label: FACT official paper and revision; UNVERIFIED official repository, data revision, schema, and licence

sources.identity: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.revision: January 2023; official page states released 2023-01-26 and AI RMF 1.0 is being revised
sources.licence: NIST technical-series statement grants reprint/derivative rights for NIST-authored works; third-party-authored NIST works may be copyrighted
schema_evidence: Core functions are GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.
MEASURE 2.13 calls for evaluation of the effectiveness of employed TEVV metrics and processes.
MEASURE 3.2 addresses settings where metrics are unavailable or difficult to assess.
MANAGE includes post-deployment monitoring and measurable continual-improvement activities.
blockers: Official page states AI RMF 1.0 is under revision; future revision identity is unavailable.
The framework is a risk-management framework, not a source for the project-specific visibility formula.
sources.label: FACT official source wording; INFERENCE bounded mapping to Stage E governance
